child_records.label: Call summary note

values.hs_note_body: Discovery, 34 min, Lena Fischer (Head of RevOps). Situation: April merger left two CRMs running side by side. Pain: nobody trusts either number; the board deck took 11 days and shipped with two wrong figures. Decision: written evaluation across three vendors, reference call, CFO Anton Weiss signs — no pilot. Timeline: live before the February fiscal year start, decision mid-October. Competition: Beacon, board-recommended. New name: Priya Nandi, would run the migration. Next step: evaluation template to Lena, back by Aug 20.

child_records.quote: Set the scene for me, what is going on internally that made this a priority now?
child_records.rationale: The activity record of the call, associated to the deal.

undetermined.why: The 11-day board deck was described but never converted into money or headcount. No impact number was offered and none was asked for.
No date, no event, no deadline mentioned anywhere in 41 minutes.
